wiki_acceptance: A gated test asserts research accrues on a bench -> tech unlocks (bow) -> bow becomes buildable/usable as ONE PASS line.
chain_steps: Step 1: ResearchManager has simple_bow tech; reset to currentPoints=0, completed=false, activeTech=bowTech — confirmed incomplete
Step 2: ResearchBench spawned at (300,0,0); PawnEntity spawned at same position (distance 0 < researchRadius 1.5); wait 1.5s; assert currentPoints rose above 0 (research accrued)
Step 3: Pre-seed currentPoints = requiredPoints - 2; wait 3s for Update ticks to complete; assert bowTech.completed == true
Step 5: canShoot predicate = (arrowSprite != null) && IsUnlocked('simple_bow') == true — bow ability now gated-open

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: ResearchManager.Instance routes through Services.Get<ResearchManager>(); may be null in the headless test scene. Test bootstraps one when absent (same pattern as V4/V5).
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Test adds AddComponent<ResearchManager> to a fresh GameObject when Instance is null.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: ResearchBench.researchRadius is [SerializeField] private (default 1.5). Test places pawn at distance 0 (same position as bench), which is always inside any positive radius. No reflection needed.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Pawn placed at bench transform.position; distance = 0 < 1.5.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: ResearchBench.cachedPawns is a private static cache; nextPawnSearchTime initializes to -10f so the first Update call refreshes it. No reflection needed; test waits one frame after pawn spawn.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: yield return null after pawn spawn allows cache refresh on next Update.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: PawnAbilities and PawnTraits are absent from the test pawn; ResearcherSpeedSum() falls back to mul=1.0 per its null-guards ('abil != null ? ... : 1f' and 'if (traits != null) mul *= ...'). Speed sum = 1.0, accrual = 2 pts/s.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Null-guards already in production code handle absent components.

api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.description: PawnUtilityAI.HandleDraftedCombat is private; the test reconstructs the canShoot predicate directly using the two public READ-ONLY operands: (a) SetArrowSprite() public accessor confirms sprite is set; (b) IsUnlocked('simple_bow') confirmed in step 4. FLAG: if PawnUtilityAI ever exposes a public CanShoot property, prefer it over the reconstructed predicate.
api_gaps_flagged_for_qa.workaround: Predicate reconstructed as: arrowSprite != null && ResearchManager.Instance.IsUnlocked('simple_bow'). Matches the exact runtime path in PawnUtilityAI.cs lines 202-204.
